opening.argument: The video presents a broad set of online income ideas as instruction and inspiration, not as a guaranteed financial outcome. Its stated purpose is to share “10 of my online income streams to help inspire you to make some of your own,” and it gives concrete operational guidance, including monetizing skills through consulting and arranging calls through a Calendly link. The Oxygen segment is expressly identified as sponsored and describes a $25 reward only after “completing qualifying activity.” The accompanying description states that the ideas are not personal or financial advice and are not a guarantee of similar results. On the supplied evidence, no deception or undisclosed requirement is established.
